One person (A) stands several meters ahead in the narrow unfinished corridor, facing the camera wearer and occupying their forward path. The wearer appears to be carrying a long level with an orange end projecting forward; it is the only relevant item visible and can be handed over after closing the short distance. There is no pool, classroom, or financial setting. Therefore, the appropriate action is to hand person A the level, as a normal act of assistance.
